prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one landscape concept sheet proposing an ORIGINAL fantasy dungeon character style combining RimWorld's economical compact pawn construction with Darkest Dungeon's expressive black ink shadows. Image 1 actual RimWorld screenshot: reference ONLY the compact floating torso pawns, absent legs, few clear layers, overhead map readability. Image 2 official Darkest Dungeon art: reference angular brow and nose, dark eye sockets, bold black shadow masses, irregular tapered ink contour, muted parchment/iron/oxblood palette. Do not copy its characters, outfits or composition. Image 3 our tile atlas: reference first-row flagstones for background floor under the small samples. Sheet contains THREE LARGE south-facing versions of the SAME original adult brown-haired human warrior in a row: left simple grey-brown basic tunic, center plain iron breastplate over same tunic, right exactly same iron armor plus straight steel sword viewer left and small round wooden shield viewer right. Same head, pose, proportions, baseline, compact body footprint and facial identity across all three. This is visual equipment progression, not three different classes. NO LEGS or feet; compact broad-shouldered bust with short torso ending below waist. Head about 42 percent of total height, shoulder width 1.4 times head width; torso visibly SHORT AND BROAD, not a long tapered tube. Tiny hands only where required to grip sword/shield, no elaborate articulated arms. Black angular brow shadows with eyes mostly lost in shadow, ONE sharp nose highlight, short stern mouth, simple short dark brown hair. Apply dark ink in a few purposeful broad shapes under brow, one cheek, under chin and armor overlaps; retain substantial light face and mid-grey chest areas so character does not disappear into dark floor. Body should use only 2-3 flat values per material. Graphic 2D ink cutout illustration, NOT detailed painting, no crosshatching, scratches, tiny seams, grain, soft gradients, 3D polygon facets or photorealism. NOT cute round blank-faced egg pawns. Bottom strip: three small corresponding versions on one continuous subdued charcoal flagstone floor, to show map readability. Large upper versions on plain warm light-grey neutral backdrop for inspection. No text labels, no UI, no frame, no watermark, no glow, no crimson rim light, no copied insignia. Maintain exact same head and body design across equipment states. Broad weapon and shield silhouette clearly separated from torso. Strong dark fantasy mood through shape and ink, not detail density. Render as a polished style exploration sheet; not claiming separate usable layers.
